scientific_motivation.predecessor_result: nonlinear learner consensus improved positive-state recovery but retained observation-confounded overresolution; adding true effort as an ordinary nuisance covariate did not fix the safety failure
scientific_motivation.new_question: Can explicit observation-process separation (training-only nuisance gate, inverse propensity correction, and nuisance marginalization from ecological scores) support process-state inference under an expanded information system without treating learner agreement as a truth certificate?

effort_unavailable.reference: original occurrence-distribution oracle, including structural observation-confounded unresolved override

effort_conditioned_upper_bound.method: process_challenge_learner with log_sampling_effort declared exclusively as an observation predictor; retained in all process knockouts, marginalized from ecological score, and used for training-only inverse-propensity correction when the nuisance gate activates
effort_conditioned_upper_bound.reference: effort-conditioned occurrence-distribution oracle: same exact occurrence distribution and process closures, log_sampling_effort added as a non-process predictor retained in every knockout, structural observation-confounded unresolved override removed
effort_conditioned_upper_bound.interpretation: simulation-privileged upper bound, not a field-ready GBIF correction and not the same estimand as effort-unavailable ODO

smoke.purpose: API/denominator/reference-separation smoke only; scientific state outcomes may not tune thresholds or learners

prospective_estimands_if_activated: exact five-state agreement against the information-system-matched ODO reference
positive ODO-state recovery among contributory|required targets
false sharp positive among replaceable targets
method availability and stable process-state coverage
hard_boundaries: Never score the effort-conditioned method against the effort-unavailable ODO as if they had the same information set.
Never call true simulator effort a field-ready observation covariate.
Do not tune margins, learners, weights, worlds or seeds after 93001-93003 opening.
Do not reinterpret M5, PR279, PR280 or real-v5 outcomes.
No real plant data are accessed in this programme.
